parts:
Hi everyone

Last chance to enroll in our upcoming 2-day seminar Introduction to Survey Methodology, running Nov 28 - 29. This seminar addresses both theoretical and practical facets of survey methodology, ensuring participants not only understand the principles but also see how these are applied in the real world, making complex concepts accessible and immediately applicable to participants’ ongoing and future research projects. After the workshop, participants will be better prepared to design surveys that yield high-quality, actionable data, while mitigating common pitfalls in survey research and enhancing the overall validity and reliability of their findings.

Sign up today to secure your spot in this unique events, and please feel free to tell your friends and colleagues.


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Director
Institute for Statistical and Data Science
